* Tens of thousands of [[Thailand|Thai]] anti-government protesters continue their rally against the country's current [[Prime Minister of Thailand|Thai Prime Minister]] [[Thaksin Shinawatra]] today. They also demand his resignation from the post. The opposition leader, [[Sondhi Limthongkul]], declared he and his party would not stop protesting all day and night until the PM resigns.
